maintenance_led.reason: Most revenue is OEM sales of locks, keys, latches and power access systems for new vehicles; aftermarket is smaller.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are automotive OEMs (Stellantis, GM, Ford etc.) paid by private vehicle buyers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through OEM programs and product development of latches, power access and keys; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Latches, locks and power access are safety-related components qualified into OEM vehicle programs; switching needs re-qualification.
